hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && pnpm exec prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && mkdir -p .claude/hooks/state && printf '%s\n' "$f" >> .claude/hooks/state/last-edited-files; } 2>/dev/null || true

f=.claude/hooks/state/last-edited-files; if [ -s "$f" ]; then sort -u "$f" | while read -r p; do git check-ignore -q "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$p"; done | xargs -r -d '\n' git add -- && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore(claude): auto stage+commit" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>"; rm -f "$f"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
